name: ta
description: TA: a Firefox sidebar study companion. Jot beside the lecture; the TA answers and checks under your notes from a precomputed concept brain.

scripts.dev: npx wrangler pages dev site --kv TA_KV --binding TA_TOKEN=devtoken --binding TA_MOCK=1 --port 8789
scripts.dev:live: npx wrangler pages dev site --kv TA_KV --binding TA_TOKEN=devtoken --port 8789
scripts.ext: cd extension && zip -qr ../ta-extension.zip . -x '.*' && echo wrote ta-extension.zip
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name ta-kb
